notes: Rear I/O diagram is a schematic layout for orientation — not a photograph of every PCB revision.
Windows rarely maps a device to an exact physical hole; USB hotspots show controller lanes and common rear-panel groups.

notices.title: Keep BIOS current on 14th-gen Intel builds
notices.plainEnglish: Intel 14th-gen CPUs on Z790 benefited from microcode/BIOS updates for stability. Check ASUS BIOS page if you see random reboots or WHEA errors.

notices.title: AURA LED Controller may show as disabled
notices.plainEnglish: Armoury Crate / Aura related USB interfaces often appear disabled in Device Manager on purpose. That is usually Fine, not a broken port.

notices.title: Only one Bluetooth stack at a time
notices.plainEnglish: Onboard Intel Wi‑Fi/BT plus an ASUS USB-BT500 dongle often conflict — one stack wins, the other fails to start (Code 10/43).
